prompt: Create exactly a transparent one-column four-row atlas. Rows top-to-bottom: BUBBLE GLASS SAND CHAMBER FRONT, TOP, BOTTOM, REAR. First/only reference is the authoritative Dark target source and its accepted current side projections, showing source material and style. Preserve its identity and geometry: this is an OPEN CORNER made of two joined transparent-blue glass wall arms around a sand mound, with THREE posts total (two open endpoints plus one shared elbow), not a closed box with four posts. Render these four principal views: Row1: Flat frontal elevation of the front L-wall arm only, camera straight at wall. Exactly two wall-end posts, with the shared corner post visibly part of the three-post total across the open corner. Show blue transparent glass panel in thin dark/gold frame and sand mounded behind/at floor; no perspective, no third independent wall or fourth corner post. Row2: Direct overhead view of the OPEN L-shaped glass corner and sand mound. Exactly three blue/gold post-cap locations: two ends of first arm and the shared elbow; the second arm shares that elbow and terminates in the third post. Preserve open corner, do not close into four-post rectangle. Thin blue translucent glass rails/edges and sand visible inside. No upright posts/pyramids, no fourth cap. Row3: Direct underside view of the same OPEN three-post L footprint, with three post/root contacts in corresponding locations; opaque golden sand/stone substrate underside within the L enclosure. No fourth post or closed rectangle. This is a below-camera plane, no upright wall faces. Row4: Level opposite horizontal elevation of the OTHER L-wall arm, camera square to it. Show one broad framed blue translucent-glass panel with the two endpoint posts from this elevation, same height as FRONT. Exactly three posts total around the complete L object: shared corner post plus one far-end post on each arm. Preserve target cyan glass, gold-blue post caps, sand behind; no perspective and no four-post closed box. Strict orthographic axis-aligned cameras. Keep the open L topology and post count consistent in top/bottom and elevations; use the target blue transparent glass, gold rim and cyan cap palette. Every cell is a separate complete projection, no grid/text, generous transparent gutter, no spill/cross-cell contamination, crisp pixel art, no perspective/isometric/lighting glow. Hidden structure inferred only where required, do not close the real open end.
